svg.title: How the blueprint bot verifies a release before it updates
svg.desc: The blueprint bot takes the latest published release of its source. It checks that the release is immutable, that its tag points at a commit of the main branch of the source, and that the release workflow of the source signed the tag with gitsign. Only when all three hold does Copier update to exactly that tag; otherwise the run fails and nothing changes. In the source, only the release app may create a release tag, and nobody may move or delete one.
